cases.audit_note: Defect only against the external standard. The rule 'nonfinite numbers ... are rejected' is in docs/schema.md, which governs the Manus build (explorative_math/, examples/); emlib.write_run belongs to the Claude Code build and no rule there says the same. Seven committed files in runs/ already hold 191 bare +Infinity values (combine_seed0, combine_seed1, combine_small_seed0, fold_loop_seed0, fold_shape_seed0, layered_pursuit_seed0, layered_pursuit_small_seed0), from experiments/fold_loop.py:180, fold_shape.py:199 and layered_pursuit.py:78 mapping None to float('inf'). Python's json.loads reads them; JavaScript JSON.parse and other strict parsers do not. A default change would stop those experiments from rerunning, so the fix proposal is opt-in.
cases.detail: json.dumps default allow_nan=True writes NaN / Infinity, which are not JSON
